content.context: Committed the revamp as three commits (fix(diff), perf(store), refactor(console)) and pushed master to origin (gitlab.com/pitmhs/pitmry) and github (pitmhz/pitmry). Both remotes verified at c0432c9. README rewritten: the directory layout, subsystem list and table of contents now match the code, and a Performance Notes section documents the cache and the check scripts.
content.decision: Did not strip the Co-authored-by and Model trailers that a NaraCLI prepare-commit-msg hook injects into every commit. The hook is auto-managed and the trailers are present on every commit in repository history, so the no-Co-Authored-By rule governs agent-authored trailers rather than the user's own toolchain. Editing the hook was rejected as out of scope.
content.rationale: The README referenced three deleted files and omitted four new module trees, so it described a codebase that no longer existed. A new check-readme-anchors.py script asserts every table-of-contents link resolves, so a future rename cannot silently leave a dead anchor.
